description: Fetches the full markdown content of any VertoDigital page by its URL slug - service pages, case studies, blog posts, about, and more. Valid slugs are listed in vertodigital_get_site_index's output. Read-only, no side effects, reflects the live markdown mirror. An unrecognized slug returns an error result rather than throwing.

slug.description: URL path of the page without leading slash or extension. Examples: "about", "services", "case-studies/ironscales", "services/inbound/b2b-and-saas-linkedin-advertising". Valid slugs are listed in vertodigital_get_site_index's output.

name: vertodigital_get_page
